text:
The point \( z \) is rotated around \( c \) by an angle of \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) counter-clockwise. In the complex plane, rotation around a center \( c \) by angle \( \theta \) is given by:

\[
w - c = (z - c) e^{i\theta}
\]

Here, \( z = 2 + \sqrt{2} - (3 + 3\sqrt{2})i \) and \( c = 2 - 3i \).  
Compute \( z - c \):

\[
z - c = \bigl[(2 + \sqrt{2}) - 2\bigr] + \bigl[(-3 - 3\sqrt{2}) - (-3)\bigr]i = \sqrt{2} - 3\sqrt{2}\,i = \sqrt{2}(1 - 3i)
\]

Multiply by \( e^{i\pi/4} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}(1 + i) \):

\[
(z - c) e^{i\pi/4} = \sqrt{2}(1 - 3i) \cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}(1 + i) = \frac{2}{2}(1 - 3i)(1 + i) = (1 - 3i)(1 + i)
\]
\[
= 1 \cdot 1 + 1 \cdot i - 3i \cdot 1 - 3i \cdot i = 1 + i - 3i + 3 = 4 - 2i
\]

Add \( c \) to get \( w \):

\[
w = c + (4 - 2i) = (2 - 3i) + (4 - 2i) = 6 - 5i
\]

Answer: \( 6 - 5i \)
